reason: The hypothesis combines the well-known idea of heat-treatment-induced intermetallic precipitation (from P1, P5, P11, P14, P16, P20) with the separate observation that passivating films improve corrosion resistance (from P3, P4, P7, P8, P10) and the layered oxide formation mechanisms in HEAs (from P22-P26, P31). It explicitly links the precipitated Mg-rich intermetallics as a structural mediator that simultaneously enhances both corrosion and high-temperature oxidation behavior, a mechanistic connection that none of the passages makes. This synthesis of corrosion and oxidation improvement through a single microstructural evolution step goes beyond the individual findings.
